What is it?
This benefit is available at checkout and gets you free delivery from your favourite shops and restaurants for 90 days. No subscription required, no automatic renewals.
How do I get 90 days of free delivery?

To buy {brand}+ Premium, add it to your order at checkout. You can use this benefit as often as you like on orders from participating shops and restaurants. At the end of 90 days, you can buy this benefit again at checkout.
Can I cancel my Just Eat+ Premium?

Yes, you can. Your 14-day cooling-off period will start the day after you purchase this pass. By continuing to use your benefit during the cooling-off period, you acknowledge that you will lose your legal right to a full refund. If you decide to cancel, any refund can take 14 days to process and will be credited to your original payment method.
Is there a limit to how many times I can use this benefit?
There is no limit. You can use this benefit as much as you like (for your own personal use) at participating shops and restaurants.
How do I get free delivery for another 90 Days?
Once expired, you can pay for this benefit along with the rest of your order at checkout.

messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.header.title: Food ordering the smart way.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.header.text: Listen up! No matter if you're rushing to an important meeting, watching your favourite TV show on a lazy Saturday afternoon or commuting on the train - with us, your favourite dishes are always ready to go. Regardless of your location. With the {sitename} app now available on your preferred smart devices, we've got you covered right through to when your meal arrives.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.footer.title: Order food the easy way
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.footer.text: Are you feeling like a delicious pizza, salad, burger or kebab? You can easily order the most delicious meals from thousands of restaurants.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.title: Order on Mobile
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.text: You're on your way home from work and all you can think of is Paella Valenciana. Skip the shops and get your dinner delivered the moment you take your shoes off. Order on the go, straight from your mobile phone. Quick and easy. Inside or outside. Totally up to you!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.andro: Convenient food delivery anywhere. With the {sitename} app on Android, delicious food is just a few moments away.

No matter if you're walking through life with a dodgy mobile phone borrowed from your older sister or you've invested in the newest gadget out there, the {sitename} app for Android is running smoothly on all kinds of phones. In a nutshell: Ordering delicious meals is super quick. All it takes for you is to sign in, personalise your search, pick from a variety of options or simply reorder previous favoured bites. Take that!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.iosDe: Intuitive and smooth, with the {sitename} app on iPhone food delivery has never been more convenient.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.iosEx: For people on the move we've created the {sitename} app. Ordering beloved dishes via your iPhone is super quick. Sign in, personalise your search, pick from a variety of options or simply reorder previous favoured bites. Now it's time to unwind and let us take care of the rest.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.webDe: Browse conveniently through thousands of menus, wherever you're feeling hungry. The park. The gym. The boat. You choose.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.mobile.webEx: The good news is: For those of you, who've jam-packed their mobile storage with selfies or cute puppy videos and prefer accessing all our features, filters and personalization options via the web browser - you can! No need to download and install the {sitename} App to get your midnight snack delivered to your after-party location.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.iosDe: Order tasty dishes on a big screen while on the go! Smoothly via the {sitename} app on your iPad.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.iosEx: With the {sitename} app on your iPad, you're equipped for ordering whatever you fancy on a big screen and with all available features in sight. Whether out on a daily commute or a picnic on your rooftop, your culinary needs will be met wherever you are.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.andro: Scroll through rip roaring flavours, wherever, whenever. Easily and clearly displayed via the {sitename} App on your Android Tablet.

Optimize your order with personalised features such as cuisine types, reviews or delivery costs, all on one screen. With the {sitename} App for your Android Tablet, ordering delicious meals is truly a walk in the park. Believe us. Day in and day out.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.webDe: Browse conveniently through thousands of menus, wherever you're feeling hungry. The park. The gym. The boat. You choose.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.webEx: The good news is: For those of you, who've jam-packed their tablet storage with selfies or cute puppy videos and prefer accessing all our features, filters and personalization options via the web browser - you can! No need to download and install the {sitename} app to get your midnight snack delivered to your after-party location.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.title: Order on Tablet
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tablet.text: You're at your in-laws, scrolling through old family photos on your tablet, when all of a sudden your appetite for green curry shows up. Don't fret! Get everyone on board and order a delicious family meal right then and there, conveniently via your device.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.title: Order on your TV
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.text: Couch potato for a day! Yes, we'd love that too. Even better: Order that mouthwatering lasagne dish you had last week directly via your TV without ever having to miss a second of your favourite TV show, curling match or relaxation program. Living it up!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.appleTvDe: Stream, order, eat and enjoy. It's this simple, with the {sitename} app on your Apple TV! Piece of pizza.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.appleTvEx: We are proud to inform you that our easy-to-use {sitename} app can be used within the sleek Apple TV environment. Make use of it's great design and browse seamlessly through dozens of restaurants near you. Found something you like? Great! Simply place your order directly via the remote and in no time your food is on it’s way. Prefer Siri to take over? Why not give her a go at ordering via our app?
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.xboxDescr: Satisfy your cravings while showing off your FIFA skills. Order food via the {sitename} app on your Xbox One!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.xboxExtra: We’ve all been there: you’re in the middle of an intense game and your tummy starts rumbling. But what do you do? Hit pause, head out to the kitchen and cook up a storm? No need for that with the {sitename} app. Just hit pause, switch to the App and order. All in a few easy steps and without ever having to let go of your controller. You're back gaming in no-time!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.samsungDe: Scroll through hundreds of menus on a large scale screen and simply place your order via the {sitename} app.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.samsungEx: If you’re the owner of a Samsung Smart TV, you’re in for a treat. Install the {sitename} app and access dozens of amazing restaurants in your area on a huge screen. Navigate to your favourite joint, take a look at their menu and order you selection. Added benefit: No need to buy another remote. Just use the one you were given with the TV!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.androidTv: With the {sitename} app your movie night only gets better. Order finger food directly through your device. Happy End!

Turn every TV into an easy-to-order food terminal with our App for Android TV. Just install the app directly on your Android TV or in the Nexus Player and access all delivery restaurants nearby. From now on, you’ll never have to interrupt a cosy movie night to prepare dinner or snacks ever again. Enjoy ordering food via the {sitename} app from the comfort of your couch!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.horizonDe: Dinner in front of the TV? Go for it! Convenient food ordering via the {sitename} app on Horizon!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.tv.horizonEx: Already loving all of your Ziggo TV features? Then keep on reading, With the Ziggo Mediabox XL your movie nights just souped up. Via the {sitename} app, it's now possible to order your favourite food while enjoying the latest blockbuster or award-winning documentary. Just open the app, scroll through thousands of menus and select your prefered dishes. It's as easy as that.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.fridge.title: Order on your Fridge
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.fridge.text: Your home, your soulmate. Well, almost. With the arrival of home automation, your everyday devices adapt to your needs and desires, turning your household into an intelligent hub of comfort and ease. Empty fridge? Don't worry, it will let you know! Who needs love, if you can have convenience, right?
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.fridge.famil: Order food seamlessly. With the {sitename} App integrated in your Family Hub screen, your favourite dishes are always close-by.

Get ready for the future of food ordering. Step into smart living with the {sitename} App on your Samsung Family Hub. Not only will your Smart Fridge help you create extensive shopping lists or remind you of food that is about to expire, but best of all, you get to order your favourite dishes, cooked for you by someone else, straight via the integrated Family Hub tablet. That's what we're talking about!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.desktop.text: Large or small orders, no problem at all! Take your time and select tasty dishes on a big screen with all filters in sight. Hassle-free, straight from your laptop at work, in bed or in the park. Choose from a large variety of partner restaurants and enjoy. You've got this!
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.desktop.webD: Order anywhere, anytime. No matter the device or browser, selecting tasty dishes via the {sitename} website is easily done.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.apps.desktop.webE: Hungry? Keep cool! Simply open your laptop, go to our website, add your postcode and scroll through thousands of restaurants. You know exactly what you're after? No worries. Specify your search by adding filters, such as cuisine type, reviews and delivery costs. Best of all: You've got a great overview of all features displayed on a big screen format. Dive right in and discover what we've got.
messages.consumerWebStaticPages.cookieStatement.l: We and affiliated third parties might show you ads. However, these will not be based on your interests or product preferences.
